     else_if = { limit = { has_variable = ywc_shu_port_pending_event ywc_v03_can_deliver_major = yes var:ywc_shu_port_pending_event = 1022 } remove_variable = ywc_shu_port_pending_event trigger_event = { id = ywc_shu.1022 } }
     else_if = { limit = { has_variable = ywc_shu_port_pending_event ywc_v03_can_deliver_major = yes var:ywc_shu_port_pending_event = 1023 } remove_variable = ywc_shu_port_pending_event trigger_event = { id = ywc_shu.1023 } }
     else_if = { limit = { has_variable = ywc_shu_port_pending_event ywc_v03_can_deliver_major = yes var:ywc_shu_port_pending_event = 1024 } remove_variable = ywc_shu_port_pending_event trigger_event = { id = ywc_shu.1024 } }
     else_if = { limit = { has_variable = ywc_shu_port_pending_event ywc_v03_can_deliver_major = yes var:ywc_shu_port_pending_event = 1025 } remove_variable = ywc_shu_port_pending_event trigger_event = { id = ywc_shu.1025 } }
     else_if = { limit = { has_variable = ywc_shu_port_notice_pending_event ywc_v03_can_deliver_major = yes } remove_variable = ywc_shu_port_notice_pending_event trigger_event = { id = ywc_shu.1024 } }
     if = { limit = { has_variable = ywc_shu_port_review OR = { is_at_war = yes in_default = yes has_modifier = declared_bankruptcy NOT = { ywc_shu_v03_port_execution_ready = yes } } } remove_variable = ywc_shu_port_review_due remove_variable = ywc_shu_port_review_mature set_variable = { name = ywc_shu_port_review_interrupted value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_shu_port_notice_pending_event value = 1024 } }
     if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ywc_shu_port_review_due } has_variable = ywc_shu_port_review NOT = { has_variable = ywc_shu_port_review_interrupted } ywc_shu_v03_port_execution_ready = yes NOT = { is_at_war = yes } NOT = { in_default = yes } NOT = { has_modifier = declared_bankruptcy } } set_variable = { name = ywc_shu_port_review_mature value = 1 } set_variable = { name = ywc_shu_port_pending_event value = 1025 } }
     } }
    complete = {
OR = { var:ywc_shu_port_outcome = 1 var:ywc_shu_port_outcome = 2 var:ywc_shu_port_outcome = 3 }
}
    fail = {
OR = { has_variable = ywc_shu_port_withdrawn var:ywc_shu_port_outcome = 4 }
}
